paper.title_en: Coexistence of Ferromagnetic and Overscreened Kondo Effects in a Single Molecule
paper.abstract_en: The quest for quantum ground states beyond the Fermi-liquid paradigm remains a central challenge in many-body physics. The ferromagnetic Kondo effect is an intriguing variant of the Kondo effect in which an asymptotically free spin gives rise to singular Fermi-liquid behavior. Despite its theoretical importance, this regime has eluded experimental observation owing to subtle spectroscopic signatures, small energy scales, and symmetry constraints in nanostructures. Here, we demonstrate the coexistence of ferromagnetic and overscreened Kondo effects within a molecular spin system---a triangulene dimer comprising spin-1 and spin-1/2 units adsorbed on a metal surface. Low-temperature scanning tunneling spectroscopy reveals signatures of singular Fermi-liquid behavior, supported by many-body calculations. The molecular design provides control over spin configuration and coupling asymmetry, allowing distinct regimes within the same platform. Our results establish a strategy for realizing non-Fermi-liquid physics at the atomic scale and demonstrate that ferromagnetic Kondo behavior can be deliberately engineered in molecular systems.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在分子自旋体系中实现铁磁与过屏蔽近藤效应共存，涉及非费米液体行为与奇异费米液体谱学特征，属于凝聚态强关联理论方向，与全息凝聚态中的非费米液体主题相关；实验与多体计算结合，方法信号较强，主题新颖，摘要表述清晰。
decision.title_zh: 单分子中铁磁与过屏蔽近藤效应的共存
decision.abstract_zh: 寻找超越费米液体范式的量子基态仍然是多体物理中的核心挑战。铁磁近藤效应是近藤效应中一个引人注目的变体，其中渐近自由的自由自旋导致奇异的费米液体行为。尽管其具有理论重要性，但由于光谱特征微妙、能量尺度小以及纳米结构中的对称性约束，这一区域一直未能被实验观测到。在这里，我们展示了一个分子自旋体系——由自旋-1和自旋-1/2单元组成、吸附在金属表面上的三角烯二聚体——中铁磁与过屏蔽近藤效应的共存。低温扫描隧道谱揭示了奇异费米液体行为的特征，并得到多体计算的支持。该分子设计提供了对自旋构型和耦合不对称性的控制，允许在同一平台内实现不同的区域。我们的结果建立了一种在原子尺度实现非费米液体物理的策略，并证明铁磁近藤行为可以在分子体系中被有意识地工程化。
